title: Stage 6 and Stage 7 XGBoost Direct are not the same model selection protocol
evidence: Stage6 XGB Daily MAE=3.289850; Stage7 XGB Daily MAE=3.388513; control with Stage6 params under Stage7 protocol=3.289850
impact: Cannot compare the two XGBoost scores as if they came from identical hyperparameter selection.
recommendation: Report Stage 7 XGBoost as a new benchmark protocol; use Stage6-param control for reconciliation.

title: Features are generated before split, but lag/rolling appear causal
evidence: Stage2 feature code uses shift(1) before rolling; no future environmental variables are in FEATURE_COLS.
impact: Likely acceptable, but full audit should inspect every generated feature column.
recommendation: See S7_1_006; keep numerical regression test as evidence.

title: Stage 7 test period is not an independent new holdout after Stage 1-6
evidence: Stage7 uses same 20 test origins aligned with Stage6; target alignment has zero mismatched keys.
impact: Model selection must be based on validation, not smallest test MAE.
recommendation: Separate validation-selected recommendation from exploratory test-best ranking.

title: Residual FTS3-RandomForest is test-best but validation-poor
evidence: Validation Daily MAE 5.7880 vs test Daily MAE 3.0977.
impact: Do not select this model as primary method despite best test MAE.
recommendation: Use validation-selected model for recommendation and report test-best as exploratory.

title: Best hybrid improvement is very small and statistically unsupported
evidence: Hybrid FTS1-LightGBM Fixed 0.31 improves Daily MAE by about 0.0043 kWh; Wilcoxon p around 0.6009.
impact: Hybrid benefit is not a strong claim.
recommendation: Prefer Direct ML baseline unless hybrid is kept as exploratory extension.

title: Numerical feature audit found no future actual target use in lag/rolling features at forecast origins
evidence: Max feature reconstruction diff 9.416e-14; future flags 0.
impact: Supports causal availability of direct features.
recommendation: Keep this regression test with Stage 7.1 artifacts.
